name: ABRO SP-304 Multipurpose Acrylic Aerosol Spray Paint Can (400ml)
shortDescription: Quick-drying acrylic lacquer aerosol spray paint in a 400ml pressurized can, delivering high gloss, non-yellowing coverage and rust protection for metal and plastic.
overview: ABRO SP-304 Multipurpose Spray Paint is an all-weather, fast-drying acrylic resin lacquer formulated to deliver a smooth, high-gloss protective finish across metal, wood, fiberglass, rigid plastics, and machinery. Pressurized with environmentally safe hydrocarbon propellant and equipped with a self-cleaning, non-clogging 360-degree spray actuator, it deposits an even, atomized mist that dries to touch in just 10 minutes. The hardened acrylic film is resistant to chipping, UV fading, road salts, oil splashes, and water washdowns.
keyFeatures: Premium thermo-plastic acrylic lacquer formulation dries to touch in 10 minutes
High-gloss mirror finish enhances aesthetic appeal and resists scratching
Non-clog fan-spray nozzle actuator provides uniform mist with minimal overspray
Excellent corrosion and rust prevention on bare metal and weld repair zones
Resists peeling, blistering, color fading, and gasoline/solvent splashes
CFC-free ozone-friendly formulation meets environmental compliance
Available in a broad spectrum of industrial colors, gloss clears, and matte blacks
applications: Workshop machinery touch-ups, weld seam covering, and frame painting
Automotive body trim, alloy wheels, mirror covers, and bumper refinishing
Industrial electrical conduit, bracket, and enclosure color-coding
Architectural metalwork, wrought iron furniture, and display stands
